subject: Clearline: service impact RCA, corrective actions, and exec oversight
messages:
From: Matt O'Neil <matt.oneil@clearline.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden latency & error spike this AM — need ownership

David / Kimberly,

We hit a sustained latency spike and elevated 5xx rates across generation endpoints between 06:40–08:10 PT that materially increased user errors and timeouts in our checkout flow. Our SLOs degraded from 99.95% to ~98.2% for that window and customers hit a 6% conversion loss during the hour.

Attached are the Clearline bridge logs and a quick snapshot of our frontend errors. Please confirm you have a priority ticket opened and an estimate for RCA delivery + mitigation. We need an exec readout for our CTO and Ops VP by EOD Thursday.

-Matt
Matt O'Neil
Head of Platform Ops, Clearline Retail
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Matt O'Neil <matt.oneil@clearline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden latency & error spike this AM — need ownership

Matt — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We've opened SUP-5129 and kicked the incident bridge: same team on it now. High-level: preliminary signals point to a batch-mixing regression in the batching router plus increased tail latency on a subset of older quantized replicas.

Immediate next steps we are executing now:
- Stabilize: route Clearline traffic to a warm pool of low-latency model variants (10m window).
- Rollback: revert the batching-router change at 09:45 PT if stabilization doesn't finish in 15m.
- Data collection: system traces and KV cache snapshots uploaded to the incident bucket (link to follow).

We will deliver an initial RCA and short mitigation plan by EOD today and an executive-brief packet by Thursday EOD per your ask. Apologies for the customer impact — full ownership here.

-David
David Kim
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Matt O'Neil <matt.oneil@clearline.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden latency & error spike this AM — need ownership

Folks — quick update from post-bridge triage: stabilization via warm pool routing completed by 10:10 PT and error rates returned near baseline by 10:30. We still see elevated tail p99.9 on a single quantized shard group; logs attached in the incident artifact.

Kimberly (action items):
- Draft RCA (root hypothesis, correlating change, and evidence) — David to own.
- Mitigation timeline with owner and rollback plan — Karthik to own.
- Exec packet and customer comms — Marissa to draft, David to approve.

I'll book a 45m readout slot Thursday 16:00 PT for Clearline execs; Marissa, please confirm.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Incident Response
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Matt O'Neil <matt.oneil@clearline.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: DRAFT RCA + proposed corrective actions (v1)

Team — attaching draft RCA (clearline_rca_draft_v1.pdf) and mitigation_timeline_v3.xlsx. Summary here so execs don't have to parse the full doc:

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- What happened: a batching-router config change (deployed 06:28 PT) altered request coalescing thresholds which, under Clearline's short-sequence distribution, forced larger batches to older quantized replicas. Those replicas showed a kernel-level tail latency regression under mixed-quantization workloads.
- Impact: 06:40–08:10 PT, Clearline saw an effective throughput reduction and elevated 5xxs; end-user conversion impact estimated at ~6% for the hour.
- Root cause: incorrect threshold tuning + missing canary coverage for mixed-quantization path in the deployment pipeline.

Immediate corrective actions (RAID):
- Hotfix: pin Clearline routing policy to warm pool variants (complete).
- Rollback: revert the batching-router change in canary and run synthetic checks for mixed-quant models (complete).
- Mid-term: add targeted e2e canary for mixed-quantization workloads and expand perf unit tests (owner: Karthik; target: 3 weeks).
- Customer remediation: offer 10% service credit for impacted hour and dedicated postmortem readout; Marissa to propose language.

Open asks:
1) Exec approval to extend perf test coverage timeline to prioritize the mixed-quant canary (estimated 3w).
2) Signoff on customer credit and the comms draft.

I'll incorporate feedback and post v2 of the RCA by tomorrow morning.

-David
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt O'Neil <matt.oneil@clearline.com>
Date: 2028-11-08T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DRAFT RCA + proposed corrective actions (v1)

Thanks, David. Draft looks solid. A few edits to customer-facing language to avoid technical overload; suggested comms excerpt attached to mitigation_timeline_v3.xlsx.

On the exec asks: I recommend we route the approval through the Platform Leadership Sync on Thursday prior to the readout and get a written OK on the 10% credit. Kimberly — can you confirm the 45m slot at 16:00 PT on Thursday still works for Clearline? Matt, please confirm attendance for CTO + Ops VP; we'll block a Zoom.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt O'Neil <matt.oneil@clearline.com>
Date: 2028-11-09T17:24:00-07:00
Subject: Final RCA v2, exec packet, and action tracker (closure)

Team / Matt — attaching final RCA v2 (drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d_rca_draft) and action tracker exported from SUP-5129. Summary of decisions and owners:

- Approval: Platform leadership signed off on expanding mixed-quant canary and the 3-week timeline; Karthik to present milestone cadence weekly.
- Customer remediation: agreed 10% service credit for the impacted hour; Marissa to finalize invoice/credit entry and confirm DocuSign where required.
- Engineering commitments: automated perf gating for batching-router changes (owner: Karthik; M-0: test design, M-2: integration into CI).
- Monitoring: new guardrail alert for p99.9 tail deviation for mixed-quant subsets (owner: Kimberly; SLA: 2 weeks to deploy).

Closing notes: we will continue to run follow-through sprints until all tracker items are green. Please review the action tracker and flag any missing owners by EOD Monday. Matt — appreciate the collaboration; we'll share the finalized exec packet after Marissa's comms edits.

-David
David Kim
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
